task_title: Floor 4 slice 1: floor plumbing + authored arena map

plan_review.notes: Adversarial plan review before any code. 4 alternatives enumerated and argued against (generic ArenaGenerator reuse, hand-authored tile JSON, deferring the Green Room to slice 5, generating the venue from RNG like other floors). 4 BLOCKER + 5 MAJOR + 2 MINOR. Design forked on: slice-1 done-when vs FR9.4 (ship the tunnel open + amend the spec), generator config path (new MapConfig.showcaseArena block), feed-gate ownership (publish ordered FloorMap.feedGates instead of re-deriving in slice 3), FR8.4 backstop is not a countdown (hideFloorTimer + own goal flag), and dropping the planned placeholder enemy pack in favour of an optional enemyPackId.

rounds.notes: Exhaustive pass over the branch diff. Zero code findings (correctness, determinism, layer boundaries, runtime wiring, security and regression coverage all reported clean). The single finding was process-level: this ledger was still unfilled at review time, which is resolved by recording these stages.

Adjudicator (gemini-3.1-pro-preview) upheld 3 concerns not raised by either reviewer: (1) the floor4 superRefine omits the tunnel-mouth vs east-feed-gate collision check it claims to cover, so a bad manifest passes load validation and throws at generation; (2) no unit coverage for initializeFloor4Scenario (hideFloorTimer, spawn, stat modifiers) or floor4ObjectiveTick (stall backstop); (3) no unit coverage asserting the new superRefine rules actually reject invalid geometry. UNRESOLVED — session hit its time limit before round 2. Next session must fix all three, run round 2, then the independent grade.
